source: PHC Core Rules v1.0 (Classes) + PHC Class Roster, Revision 3 (docs/design/class-roster-rev3-proposal.md, accepted 8 Nov 2026)

assignment.score: Each base class belongs to one of the nine attributes.
assignment.eligible: At level 3 you get the class of your highest attribute. If several attributes are tied for highest, you can take the class of any of them.
assignment.tie_rule: On a tie the player chooses among the tied classes. Nobody goes without a class.
assignment.fixed: The class you get at level 3 is yours for good.
assignment.rank_rule: Each rank gives you the class's two moves of that rank. Rank II needs the class's own attribute at 5 and level 6. Rank III needs it at 8 and level 12.
assignment.moves: a rank's move is either written in full (a Revision 3 move) or {"ref": "<origin>.<moveId>"}: a move from the pool or an advanced class, kept under its old key class:<origin>.<moveId>

advanced.shelved_text: Advanced classes are being rebuilt; not learnable yet.
advanced.held_rule: A character who already holds an advanced class keeps it on the sheet, but it gives no moves, resources or effects until advanced classes can be learned.
advanced.hybrid_rule: A hybrid class pairs its base attribute with an attribute from another Core.
advanced.squared_rule: A squared class pairs its base attribute with itself.

assignment.patrons: Prayer is not a class: any character with Faith 3 or more can pray (the Faithful to their patron, an Atheist by dice).

resource.rule: Guard is a pool of up to 5 points, and Brace fills it. While you hold Guard you Interpose: when an enemy's weapon attack hits an ally next to you, you spend 1 Guard and your reaction and take the hit yourself, with your own armour. Each point of Guard can also take 10 damage off a hit on you. Guard is lost when the fight ends.

moves.name: Shrug It Off
moves.text: When you become Bleeding, Slowed, Weakened or Prone, it ends at once. Costs {=effects.0.cost.value} Guard and your reaction, and happens by itself whenever you have both.

moves.name: Anchor
moves.text: While you are Braced, you can't be pushed, pulled or knocked Prone. An enemy that starts its turn next to you and then moves out of your reach provokes your opportunity attack, even if it Disengages. The attack uses your reaction.

resource.rule: Momentum is a pool of up to 5 points, and you start each fight with 1. Each hit with a plain melee attack, a Lunge, a Riposte or a Finisher gives 1. On your first melee attack each turn you also gain 1 for each tile you closed on the target that turn, up to 2. Each tile you walk costs 1, and so does each hit you take, unless you Parry it or your Guard takes part of it. Momentum carries over from turn to turn and is lost when the fight ends.

moves.name: Shove
moves.text: Costs 1 AP. Push an enemy next to you 1 tile straight back, or knock it Prone: your choice. It makes a Body save against 12 + your strength with Raw Power, and nothing happens if it succeeds. You can't push it into a wall or another unit.

moves.name: Unstoppable
moves.text: Costs 1 AP, once per scene. Until your next turn starts, Fear, Shaken, Slowed and Pinned don't affect you, and nobody gets an opportunity attack on you. You also gain {=effects.3.value} Momentum. Any of those conditions you already had are only set aside: they come back when it ends.

base.name: Marksman
base.tagline: The gun hand and quick feet.

resource.rule: Guns build Heat: +1 for a single shot, +2 for a burst, +4 for full auto. Every 2 Heat is −1 to hit, and at the weapon's Heat limit the gun jams (2 AP to clear). Heat falls by 2 at the start of each of your turns. Bows build no Heat and have no recoil; they are silent and their damage grows with Raw Power.

moves.name: Speed Loader
moves.text: Your first reload each turn costs 1 AP less, but never less than 1 AP. It doesn't apply to your off-hand gun or to reloading two guns at once.

moves.name: Duck and Roll
moves.text: When a ranged weapon attack targets you, you step 1 tile before it is rolled, for no AP. It uses your reaction and happens by itself when a step helps. If the step takes you out of the attacker's sight, the attack isn't made; if it takes you into cover, the attack is at {=effects.2.value} to hit.

base.name: Infiltrator
base.tagline: See first, strike first, fix what breaks.

resource.rule: You can keep up to 3 enemies Marked at once. You carry 2 toxin doses, +1 for every 3 points of Ingenuity, restocked when you rest.

moves.name: Vanish
moves.text: Costs 1 AP, once per turn. If no enemy can see you right now (fog, smoke, full cover, darkness), you become Hidden. You can't Vanish while you are Marked.

repair.text: a repair, not a heal: no healing multipliers

moves.name: Field Fix
moves.text: Costs 2 AP. Do one of three things for an ally next to you: clear their jammed weapon, restore some of their weapon's durability, or repair a robot, drone, turret or machine for {=effects.1.repair} HP. The repair also brings a Downed machine back up.

moves.name: Sabotage
moves.text: Costs 2 AP. Disable an enemy machine, turret or drone next to you for {=effects.1.duration_rounds} rounds, or make a barricade next to you stop blocking the way for {=effects.1.duration_rounds} rounds. Or rig your own tile: the next enemy to step on it takes {=effects.2.damage} damage, stops there, and makes a Body save against 12 + your strength with Ingenuity or is Pinned. You can have one rigged tile at a time.

base.name: Mage
base.tagline: The Sigil scholar: power, reach and the long script.

resource.shared_rule: Every word you draw adds 1 Flux to your Evoker, which holds 6. If it goes above 6 the Evoker overloads: you take 10 damage for each point over 6, all the Flux bursts into the ambient mana, and the Evoker is locked until the next round. Vent (1 AP) empties your Flux into the ambient mana, which rises by the amount vented.

moves.name: Core Change
moves.text: Swapping a spent mana core costs 1 AP less, but never less than 1 AP.

moves.name: Bleed the Flux
moves.text: Venting costs 1 AP less, so a 1 AP Vent is free. After you Vent, the next glyph you draw adds {=effects.1.value|abs} Flux less.

base.name: Trickster
base.tagline: Images, reading people, lying with a smile.

resource.shared_rule: Every word you draw adds 1 Flux to your Evoker, which holds 6. If it goes above 6 the Evoker overloads: you take 10 damage for each point over 6, all the Flux bursts into the ambient mana, and the Evoker is locked until the next round. Vent (1 AP) empties your Flux into the ambient mana, which rises by the amount vented.

moves.name: Read
moves.text: Analyze costs you 1 AP, and it also shows what the target means to do on its next turn.

moves.name: False Image
moves.text: Costs 2 AP and {=effects.0.cost.value} charge. Needs an Evoker in hand. A decoy of you appears on a free tile you can see within 8 tiles (plus your Sigil range bonus) and lasts {=effects.1.duration_rounds} rounds. Every enemy that can see it makes a Brain save against 12 + your strength with Brain Power, and those who fail treat the decoy as you. You can have one at a time; it fades when it is attacked or when you go down.

moves.name: Silver Tongue
moves.text: Costs 2 AP. An enemy within {=effects.0.range} tiles that can hear you makes a Brain save against 12 + your strength with Charisma. If it fails, it loses 2 AP on its next turn (a boss or a Celestial loses 1). It doesn't work on machines, turrets or drones.

moves.name: Sleight
moves.text: Costs 1 AP, once per scene. Swap places with your False Image or with a standing ally within 6 tiles. The swap provokes no opportunity attacks.

resource.rule: Supplies are your stims, kits and med-drones. You carry 3, +1 for every 2 points of Improvisation, restocked when you rest.

moves.name: Rally
moves.text: Costs 2 AP, once per scene. Every ally within {=effects.1.radius} tiles heals 6 × your Healing given, more as you level, and loses Fear and Shaken. It doesn't heal you, and it doesn't reach Downed allies.

base.name: Channeler
base.tagline: An iron will and a storm in the heart.

resource.shared_rule: Each Begin or cast adds 1 Strain (2 where the ambient mana is Flooded), and each turn you keep holding an Outburst adds 1 more. Strain falls by 1 at the start of each of your turns, and again when you calm your heart: a turn spent still, your first weapon attack of the turn, the first heal, stim, shield or cleanse you give someone each turn, letting a held Outburst go, or Steady the heart. Your Strain limit is 3, +1 for every 2 points of Will Power. At the end of your turn each point over the limit burns you for 8 damage that ignores armour. At 3 over the limit you suffer a Mana Short with no roll: you are Stunned and a held Outburst goes off wild. Strain is cleared when the fight ends. Crystallise (3 AP, needs ambient mana of 10 or more) lowers the ambient mana by 10 and makes one standard mana core.

moves.name: Iron Heart
moves.text: Your Strain limit is {=effects.0.value} higher.

moves.name: Occult Library
moves.text: You can keep one more design ready. Once, out of a fight, you learn one more Outburst tone of your choice.

moves.name: Eye of the Storm
moves.text: Once per scene, on your turn, for 0 AP: your next Release this turn adds no Strain, and its tone's rider counts as one stage higher (stage 4 at most). If you don't Release this turn, the use is lost.

base.name: Guardian
base.tagline: The saints judge, you deliver, and the squad follows.

resource.shared_rule: Each Begin or cast adds 1 Strain (2 where the ambient mana is Flooded), and each turn you keep holding an Outburst adds 1 more. Strain falls by 1 at the start of each of your turns, and again when you calm your heart: a turn spent still, your first weapon attack of the turn, the first heal, stim, shield or cleanse you give someone each turn, letting a held Outburst go, or Steady the heart. Your Strain limit is 3, +1 for every 2 points of Will Power. At the end of your turn each point over the limit burns you for 8 damage that ignores armour. At 3 over the limit you suffer a Mana Short with no roll: you are Stunned and a held Outburst goes off wild. Strain is cleared when the fight ends. Crystallise (3 AP, needs ambient mana of 10 or more) lowers the ambient mana by 10 and makes one standard mana core.

moves.name: Command
moves.text: Costs 1 AP, once per turn. Needs 1 point of Authority. An ally within {=effects.0.range} tiles moves up to {=effects.1.tiles} tiles to a tile you pick, right now and for none of their AP. It is a normal move, so it can provoke opportunity attacks.

move_pool.note: The Revision 2 base moves under their old class ids (status active: a Revision 3 class names it; shelved: no class does, its code and tests stay).

moves.name: Fire Discipline
moves.text: Aimed shots add no Heat. Once per turn, a Burst costs 2 AP instead of 3. With a bow, an Aimed shot has +3 to hit instead of +2.

moves.name: Special Ammo
moves.text: You carry one magazine (or one quiver of up to 12 arrows) each of armour-piercing, hollow-point and incendiary rounds, restocked when you rest. Loading one is a reload and costs the same AP; a quiver has to be filled before the fight. Armour-piercing ignores armour at ×0.8 damage, hollow-point deals ×1.3 damage against doubled armour, and incendiary deals ×0.9 damage and sets the target Burning.

moves.name: Killzone
moves.text: Hold two Overwatch shots instead of one, for twice the shot's AP. You fire one at each of the first two different enemies that move into your line, both at +2 to hit. The two shots use one reaction between them. You can't set it while Pressed.

moves.name: Lunge
moves.text: Costs the AP of your melee attack and {=effects.0.value|abs} Momentum. Move up to {=effects.1.value} tiles and strike an enemy, all in one action. The move provokes no opportunity attacks.

moves.name: Riposte
moves.text: When a melee attack misses you and the attacker is within your reach: strike back at once for 0 AP, adding your Counter bonus to hit. Costs {=effects.0.value|abs} Momentum and your reaction.

moves.name: Finisher
moves.text: Costs {=ap_cost} AP and all your Momentum (at least 1). Make one melee strike that deals +{=effects.0.value.per.0.value|pct}% damage for each point spent, up to +{=effects.0.value.max|more}%. The Momentum is spent even if you miss.

moves.name: Brace
moves.text: Costs {=ap_cost} AP. You gain Guard equal to your Durability points (at least 1; you hold 5 at most) and become Braced: +{=effects.2.value} Defense until you move, are pushed or are knocked Prone. While you hold Guard you Interpose: when an enemy's weapon attack hits an ally next to you, you spend 1 Guard and your reaction and take the hit yourself, with your own armour.

moves.name: Draw Fire
moves.text: Costs {=ap_cost} AP and {=effects.0.value|abs} Guard. An enemy you can see is Taunted for 1 round, with no save: its next attack must be aimed at you if it can see you, and it has −2 to hit anyone else. A boss or a Celestial isn't forced to attack you, but still has −2 to hit anyone else on its next turn.

moves.name: Reactive Plate
moves.text: Your armour is woven with bots and hardens when struck. When you take damage, Guard is spent to block it: each point takes {=effects.0.value} off the damage, as many points as the hit needs. It costs no AP and no reaction. For every {=effects.1.every} Guard spent this way the plate sheds bots, and the ambient mana rises by {=effects.1.value}.

moves.name: Triage
moves.text: Costs {=ap_cost} AP. Heal an ally next to you for 5 × your Healing given, more as you level, and end their Bleeding. It uses no Supplies, and works once per ally per turn. Out of a fight you have time to work: three times as much, once per ally per scene. You can also Stabilise a Downed ally next to you for 1 AP: they come back at 1 HP, with no stim needed.

moves.name: Stim Throw
moves.text: Costs {=ap_cost} AP and {=effects.0.value|abs} Supply. An ally within 4 tiles that you can see heals 6 × your Healing given, more as you level, and stops Bleeding. A Downed ally is stabilised at 1 HP instead.

moves.name: Field Surgery
moves.text: Out of a fight, spend {=effects.0.value|abs} Supply to do one of two things for an ally or yourself: treat one arm or leg injury, or clear every Body condition they carry. A robot medic repairs machines the same way; the Narrator decides which machines count.

moves.name: Mark
moves.text: Costs {=ap_cost} AP. An enemy you can see becomes Marked until the fight ends: your squad gets +1 to hit it, and it can't become Hidden. You can keep 3 enemies Marked; a fourth Mark lifts the oldest one.

moves.name: Toxin
moves.text: Costs {=ap_cost} AP and {=effects.0.value|abs} toxin dose. Coat a melee weapon, your arrows or a thrown weapon (never a gun) and choose Weakened, Slowed or Bleeding. Your next hit with it forces a Body save against 12 + your strength with Ingenuity, and the target takes that condition if it fails. The coat lasts until that hit or the end of the fight, and you can put it on before a fight starts.

moves.name: Execution
moves.text: When your hit leaves a Marked enemy at a quarter of its max HP or less, it dies outright. Bosses and Celestials are immune.

moves.name: Barrage
moves.text: The damage words FIRE, FREEZE, SHOCK, STONE and ACID cost {=effects.0.value|abs} charge less to draw: 1 instead of 2. SPARK and GALE already cost the least a glyph can and stay there, because no glyph costs less than 1 charge.

moves.name: Overcharge
moves.text: Once per fight, for {=ap_cost} AP: the next glyph you draw costs no charge and no AP, and its spell may hold one word more than your Max Sigil words (never more than 4 glyphs). The glyph still adds Flux.

moves.name: Payload
moves.text: Evoke a Line with double area. A SPREAD radius and a PUSH cone's length are doubled; a spell with neither fires one more missile, as one more TWICE would. On top of the Flux its glyphs already added, the Evoke adds Flux equal to its number of glyphs. A spell with STAY, WAIT or WATCH can't carry it.

moves.name: Raise Cover
moves.text: For {=ap_cost} AP and 1 charge you can Evoke a lone STAY glyph with no Subject as a cover rune, from a tile next to it: full cover on its tile and one tile next to it for 2 rounds + your Sigil duration bonus.

moves.name: Ward
moves.text: Spend 1-3 charge: an ally within 6 tiles gains a shield of 10 x charge spent x your Healing given multiplier. Adds 1 Flux per charge.

moves.name: Seal
moves.text: Spend 2 charge: a 3x3-tile zone in range where, for {=effects.0.rounds} rounds, enemy Sigils cost double charge and enemy Soul spells cost double MP.

moves.name: Quicken
moves.text: Spend 1 charge: an ally within 6 tiles gets +{=effects.0.value} AP on their next turn (AP ceiling applies). On the area map the +1 lands on this overworld round's AP.
moves.future_home: a support Sigil hybrid (Intelligence + Insight or Virtue; batch 3)

moves.name: Inscribe Gear
moves.text: Spend 2 charge (or do it out of combat): write a sigil onto an ally's weapon (+{=effects.0.value|pct}% damage) or torso armour (+5 armour value) until the next rest. One inscription per item.
moves.future_home: a support Sigil hybrid (Intelligence + Insight or Virtue; batch 3)

moves.name: Stored Spell
moves.text: Out of a fight, write a whole Sigil spell onto an object: name its words (ones you know, up to your Max Sigil words) and pay its charge now. In a fight, with an Evoker in hand, you set off your oldest stored spell for {=effects.0.ap} AP: it goes off from your tile, in every direction, with its own Reach. You can keep as many stored spells as your Rumination modifier (at least 1), and they fade at your next rest. A spell with STAY, WAIT or WATCH can't be stored. Out of a fight, the Narrator decides what a stored spell does.

moves.name: Bind
moves.text: The BIND word costs {=effects.0.value|abs} charge less, and its Body save is {=effects.1.value} harder to make.
moves.future_home: Blade Scribe (Strength + Intelligence; batch 2) or Berserker (Strength squared; batch 1)

moves.name: Blind and Slow
moves.text: You learn the condition words BLIND, SLOW and MUDDLE (Left Brain Debuff) if you don't know them yet. MUDDLE costs you 1 charge less to draw: 1 instead of 2. BLIND and SLOW already cost the least a glyph can, and no glyph costs less than 1 charge.

shield_turned.text: at most the shield it had

moves.name: Rewrite
moves.text: Costs {=ap_cost} AP and 3 charge, once per turn, and adds 1 Flux. An enemy you can see within 8 tiles (plus your Sigil range bonus) makes a Brain save against 12 + your strength with Brain Power. If it fails, one helpful state on it flips into its opposite until it would have ended: Braced becomes Prone, +2 to hit becomes −2, a shield becomes damage (at most {=amounts.shield_turned.base} × your Sigil multiplier, and armour applies; the rest of the shield is gone), Hidden becomes revealed and Marked. The engine also flips Overwatch, Guarded, Withdrawing, Inspired, Quickened and Sharpened. The Narrator decides the flip for a state the game doesn't track.

effects.note: Pick the opposite of exotic buffs.

moves.name: Shape
moves.text: While you hold a Damage Outburst, you get your one free Pump a turn even without Empathy 3. And your free Pump each turn, wherever it comes from, adds +0.1 more to the multiplier.

moves.name: Storm Front
moves.text: Once per turn, when you Begin a Damage Outburst shaped as a Bolt or a Lance, you can pay {=effects.1.value|abs} MP more. When it lands, it arcs on to up to 2 more enemies within 2 tiles of the first creature it hit. Each arc is rolled on its own, at the stage you released at, and carries the tone's rider. Wave, Burst and Aura shapes can't take it.

moves.name: Heart Surge
moves.text: Once per turn, when you Release an Outburst or snap cast one (Begin and Release at once), you can make it fire one stage higher. Past stage 4 it reads one more step of the stage table, and a snap cast fires at stage {=effects.0.value}. It costs double Strain: the Begin's Strain is added again once the Outburst lands.

moves.name: Will Shield
moves.text: A Buff-school cast: it costs your Soul cast AP and 20 MP (before the ambient mana is counted), and adds Strain like any cast. You, or an ally you can see within Soul reach, gains a shield of {=effects.0.value} × your Healing given until the fight ends. It grows with your level, like healing. If they already have a bigger shield, that one stays.

moves.name: Drink It In
moves.text: When an enemy spell hits a shield you made, its bots feed your Emanator: gain MP equal to the spell's MP cost, or 10 per Sigil word, up to your Max MP.
moves.future_home: Saint (Virtue squared; batch 1) or Adamantile Knight (Endurance + Virtue; batch 2)

moves.name: Sanctuary
moves.text: Once per scene. It costs your Soul cast AP and 60 MP, and adds 1 Strain more than a normal cast. Pick a tile you can see within Soul reach: allies on the 3×3 tiles around it, you included, take half damage until the start of your next turn. The burn from your own Strain is not halved.

moves.name: Inspire
moves.text: Costs {=ap_cost} AP and {=effects.0.value|abs} MP (without an Emanator: no MP, and {=effects.0.without_emanator.value} Strain in its place). An ally within 6 tiles gets +2 on their next d20 roll: an attack, a save or a check. With an Emanator it adds no Strain, and a second Inspire on the same ally doesn't stack.

heal.text: in place of the Buff school's base

moves.name: Mend
moves.text: Your healing Outbursts (Buff school) heal from a base of 9 instead of 7, before your Healing given, the stage, your level and the ambient mana are counted. Healing is stronger where the ambient mana is Rich or Flooded.

moves.name: Gift
moves.text: Out of combat, hand an ally one of your ready designs. They cast it once for {=effects.0.ap} AP (Begin and Release), on your MP and your Strain; it goes off at stage 1.

moves.name: Dread
moves.text: Status-school spells that inflict Fear cost {=effects.0.value} MP less, and Fear you inflict lasts 1 extra round.

moves.name: Mind Fog
moves.text: Every condition your Status Outbursts inflict has +{=effects.0.value} to its save TN.

moves.name: Puppet
moves.text: Soul cast AP, 60 MP, Heart save: you choose the target's next action. It can't be made to harm itself directly. Bosses roll the save twice and keep the better.

effects.note: Rule on what counts as harming itself.

move_pool.revision_2_note: The 13 Revision 2 base classes, for the record (where each pool move came from) and for the engine tests that still run the Revision 2 classes (test-only switch _setRevision2Classes). Not used in play.

advanced_roadmap.fantasy: One word over the whole field
Every feeling in the room is fuel
An armourless skirmisher with rallying banners
Plate that turns blows into shields
Sees the sin, delivers the sentence

advanced.name: Gunslinger
advanced.summary: Gunplay with a swordsman's footwork.

moves.name: The Draw
moves.text: Before the first initiative turn of a combat, fire one single shot with a pistol or revolver for 0 AP.

moves.name: Six for Six
moves.text: Fire up to six single shots from a pistol or revolver at targets within 4 tiles. Recoil and Heat apply to each.

moves.name: Called Shot
moves.text: Costs {=ap_cost} AP. Needs a gun or a bow. Name the head, an arm or a leg and shoot at −2 to hit. A hit causes that injury without needing a critical hit: head, Dazed; arm, −2 to attacks with that arm; leg, half Movement. A target with Injury resistance can still resist it.

advanced.name: Hellraiser Heavy
advanced.summary: Emplaced, belt-fed fire that makes ground impossible to stand on.

moves.name: Emplace
moves.text: Become Emplaced: heavy weapons lose their unemplaced penalty, you ignore recoil, and you gain +5 armour until you move.
moves.future_home: Hellraiser Heavy (Agility + Virtue or a Mind attribute; batch 3)

moves.name: Suppression
moves.text: While Emplaced, fire full auto into a 3x3-tile area. Until your next turn, any enemy there that moves or attacks takes one attack roll from you and is Pinned on a hit (Body save).
moves.future_home: Hellraiser Heavy (Agility + Virtue or a Mind attribute; batch 3)

moves.name: Belt Discipline
moves.text: While Emplaced, your weapon's Heat limit is +{=effects.0.value} and it loses 4 Heat at the start of your turn instead of 2.
moves.future_home: Hellraiser Heavy (Agility + Virtue or a Mind attribute; batch 3)

advanced.name: CCEC Ballistician
advanced.summary: Ballistics and weak points; one shot closes a case.

moves.name: Case File
moves.text: Analyze costs {=ap_cost} AP and also Marks the target.

moves.name: Weak Point
moves.text: Your Aimed shots against a Marked target ignore armour and are critical on a natural 18-20.

moves.name: One Shot
moves.text: If you haven't moved this turn, an Aimed shot at a Marked target deals triple damage (double against a Boss or a Celestial). Once per fight.

advanced.name: Banner Dancer
advanced.summary: Armourless skirmisher whose bot-thread banners shield and rally allies.

moves.name: Banner Thread
moves.text: With no torso armour (Class 0) you get +{=effects.0.value} Defense and +1 Movement.

moves.name: Rally Banner
moves.text: Plant a banner. Allies who start their turn within 2 tiles of it gain a shield of {=effects.0.value} × your Healing given (doesn't stack) while you stay within 3 tiles of it.

moves.name: Sweep
moves.text: Spend {=effects.0.value|abs} Momentum: move up to 3 tiles. Make one melee attack against each enemy you pass adjacent to; each ally you pass heals 10 × your Healing given.
moves.future_home: Berserker (Strength squared; batch 1) or Banner Dancer (Agility + Insight; batch 2)

advanced.name: RTC Contractor
advanced.summary: Credit buys supply drops, strikes and extractions.

moves.name: Supply Drop
moves.text: Spend {=effects.0.value|abs} credits: next round a crate lands within 6 tiles. Anyone adjacent can take 1 Supply or one magazine from it (1 AP).

moves.name: Strike Call
moves.text: Spend {=effects.0.value|abs} credits: at the start of your next turn, a 3x3-tile area takes 50 Physical damage. Anyone inside can spend their reaction to move 1 tile.

effects.note: No strikes where the Company has no signal.

moves.name: Extraction
moves.text: Spend {=effects.0.value|abs} credits: a Company flyer lifts the squad out after 2 rounds.

effects.note: Decide where the flyer can land and what follows.

advanced.name: Blade Scribe
advanced.summary: Evoker blades: each sword form draws a sigil.

moves.name: Sword Form
moves.text: Each melee attack can also draw one Sigil glyph on your own tile for no extra AP. It still costs charge and adds Flux.

moves.name: Edge Sigil
moves.text: A damage word drawn through Sword Form adds its element damage to that hit as Elemental damage.

moves.name: Three-Cut Script
moves.text: Three melee attacks, each drawing one word; the three words resolve as one spell after the third cut.

advanced.name: Siege Engineer
advanced.summary: Deployable cover and turrets reinforced with STAY cover runes.

moves.name: Deploy Cover
moves.text: Place a portable barricade on an adjacent tile: half cover, 40 HP. Draw a STAY glyph on a tile next to it to make it full cover.

moves.name: Sentry Turret
moves.text: Spend 2 charge: deploy a turret ({=effects.0.hp} HP, Defense 10) that fires once per round at the nearest enemy (+4 to hit, 20 damage). One at a time.

moves.name: Bulwark Line
moves.text: Until your next turn, all cover within 3 tiles that has an ally beside it counts as full cover and gains 20 HP.

advanced.name: Spellslinger
advanced.summary: Sigils inscribed on rounds: every magazine carries a stored spell.

damage.text: the inscribed word's own damage, at this share

moves.name: Inscribed Rounds
moves.text: Out of combat, spend 1 charge per round to inscribe up to 6 rounds with a one-word effect (an element or a condition word).

moves.name: Spell Magazine
moves.text: Store a full Sigil spell in a magazine. The first hit after loading it triggers the spell at the target.

moves.name: Ricochet Glyph
moves.text: When a shot misses, it can glance to another target within 4 tiles of the first: roll again at -2.

advanced.name: Storm Hand
advanced.summary: One element infused into a weapon through an Emanator gauntlet; melee hits charge it and carry the element's rider.

fire_extra.text: Fire, when the hit is not a critical

arc.text: Shock, to one enemy next to the target

moves.name: Gauntlet Infusion
moves.text: Choose one element at each rest (fire, freeze, shock or spark). Your melee hits deal +{=effects.0.value} Elemental damage of it for {=effects.1.value|abs} MP a hit (no Strain) and carry its stage-1 rider, with its effect and sound: Fire sets Burning 1 round on a critical, else +5 more; Shock chains to one enemy next to the target for half; Freeze Slows (Body save); Spark gives +1 AP on a kill.

moves.name: Charged by Battle
moves.text: Each melee hit you land gives {=effects.0.value} Charge (max {=effects.0.max}). Charges fade after combat (battle, not kills).

moves.name: Discharge
moves.text: Spend all Charges with a melee hit: everyone adjacent to the target takes 20 Elemental damage per Charge and the infused element's rider at stage N (N = the Charges spent; the Outburst tone table: fire Fire, shock Storm, freeze Frost; spark has none), with full effects and screen shake.

advanced.name: Adamantile Knight
advanced.summary: Plate that hardens when struck and turns shed bots into shields for allies.

moves.name: Adamantile Plate
moves.text: Each time Reactive Plate spends Guard, the adjacent ally lowest on HP gains a shield of 10 per Guard you lost.

moves.name: Bulwark of Will
moves.text: Brace also gives you a shield of {=effects.0.value} x your Healing given multiplier.

moves.name: Unbroken
moves.text: Once per fight, the first time damage would drop you to 0 HP, you stay at 1 HP instead and gain {=effects.0.and.0.value} Guard.

advanced.name: Shade
advanced.summary: Silent kills that leave fear behind; marked targets see their nightmares.

moves.name: Silent Kill
moves.text: A kill from Hidden doesn't reveal you.

moves.name: Nightmare Mark
moves.text: Enemies you Mark make a Heart save at the start of each of their turns or are Afraid of you (Fear) that turn.

moves.name: Lingering Dread
moves.text: When you kill an enemy, every other enemy within 3 tiles of it that saw it die makes a Heart save against 12 + your strength with Will Power, or is Shaken for 3 rounds.

advanced.name: Lumeri Templar
advanced.summary: The paladin: Blessings fired as shells, a patron watching, Judgement.

moves.name: Blessed Shells
moves.text: When a prayer of yours succeeds, you can load the Hymn into your weapon instead of using it at once. Your next hit releases it: a harmful Hymn lands on the target, a helpful one on every ally next to the target. It stays loaded until that hit or the end of the fight.

moves.name: Under the Eye
moves.text: While you are Witnessed, allies within 3 tiles of you get +2 to hit. Out of a fight they get +2 on checks the Narrator counts as on your patron's theme.

moves.name: Judgement
moves.text: Costs {=ap_cost} AP and 1 Devotion ({=effects.0.value|abs} Devotion XP), once per fight. Needs a melee weapon or a scattergun. Make one attack that deals damage × (1 + your Blessing power). The Devotion is spent even if you miss.

advanced.name: Stroke Gambler
advanced.summary: Random half-sigils stitched into whole spells.

moves.name: Half-Sigil
moves.text: Draw a random word from those you know (the engine rolls) as a half-glyph on your own tile. It costs 1 charge and adds Flux.

moves.name: Stitch
moves.text: Cast a spell built only from Half-Sigils and roll a d20: 1-5 it hits you or your nearest ally instead; 16-20 its damage doubles.

moves.name: House Edge
moves.text: Once per combat, reroll a Stitch roll.

advanced.name: Devoted
advanced.summary: A few spells, loved and boosted beyond anyone else's.

moves.name: Beloved Spells
moves.text: Choose up to 3 ready designs as Beloved. They cost 30% less MP and get +{=effects.1.value} module slot.

moves.name: Heart's Own
moves.text: While you Begin or hold a Beloved spell, your Strain limit is {=effects.0.value} higher: the burn and the Mana Short count from it.

moves.name: Love Made Manifest
moves.text: Once per combat, a Beloved Outburst Begins at stage {=effects.0.value}: the heart full at once.

advanced.name: Circuit Mage
advanced.tutor: The Institute of Forgotten Knowledge, in secret
advanced.summary: Vents and crystallises in one body: the only caster who needs nobody's cores.

requires.tutor: The Institute of Forgotten Knowledge, in secret

moves.name: Closed Loop
moves.text: When you Vent, your own Emanator takes the Flux as 10 MP per Flux instead of the air.

moves.name: Self-Crystallise
moves.text: Crystallise from your own MP: spend {=effects.0.value|abs} MP to make a standard core, ignoring the meter. As many cores between long rests as your Virtue.

moves.name: Fusion
moves.text: Cast a spell that joins Sigil words that aren't Subjects (Reach, Delivery, Burst, Filter) to a Soul school: each creature the Sigil reaches takes the Outburst as a Bolt, at stage 0 (×0.8) or at the stage you held it to. Pay both costs, +1 Strain and +2 Flux. Celestials notice.

effects.note: Each Fusion in sight of the world is a Knowing risk: decide whether a Celestial takes an interest.

advanced.name: Glyph Mason
advanced.summary: A mason's-chisel Evoker: one Keystone glyph that never fades, and the fight is planned around it.

moves.name: Keystone
moves.text: Cut a glyph on your own tile instead of drawing it ({=ap_cost} AP + {=effects.0.cost_core} standard core): it never fades, can't be scuffed, doesn't count toward your glyph limit and survives being Evoked. One at a time; it stays in that zone until you cut another.

moves.name: Survey
moves.text: You and your allies can Evoke a Line that holds your Keystone from up to 2 tiles away, and it costs 1 charge less to fire.

moves.name: Foundation
moves.text: Once per scene: this turn, glyphs you draw within 2 tiles of your Keystone cost 0 AP.

advanced.name: Grand Sigilist
advanced.summary: A staff Evoker: one word enlarged into a Grand form over the battlefield, and bare hands while the staff stands planted.

moves.name: Enlarge
moves.text: Once per combat ({=ap_cost} AP + {=effects.0.charge} charge): plant the staff and enlarge one word you know into its Grand form (sigils.json, grand) over radius 2 around the staff for {=effects.0.rounds} rounds + duration bonus. While planted you can't draw or Evoke; pulling it out (1 AP, adjacent) ends it.

moves.name: Empty Hand
moves.text: With empty hands, unarmed strikes deal {=effects.1.value} Physical for 2 AP, and you get +{=effects.0.value} Defense.

moves.name: Earthed
moves.text: Inside your own Grand form you ignore its harm, and your unarmed strikes carry its element.

advanced.name: Heartfed
advanced.summary: Every feeling in the room is fuel: Rage, Grief, Fear and Devotion fill four gauges that feed the Outbursts keyed to them.

moves.name: Four Hearts
moves.text: Four gauges, 0-{=effects.0.max}: Rage (+1 per 20 damage you take), Grief (+2 when an ally is Downed, +5 when one dies), Fear (+1 when a fight with an Elite or Boss starts, +2 when you're Shaken), Devotion (+1 when an ally heals or buffs you). Each design is keyed to one.

moves.name: Fed
moves.text: Your Outbursts cost {=effects.0.per_point|pct}% less MP per point in their key gauge. While you hold one, spend {=effects.0.pump_per_point} point of its gauge for a Pump (2 a turn). The first costs no AP; a character takes one free stage a turn, so the second costs the Pump's AP. Releasing it empties that gauge.

moves.name: Overflow
moves.text: Once per scene, when a gauge reaches 5, your next Outburst keyed to it Begins at stage 2 (the held stage itself) with no Strain.

advanced.name: Heartbinder
advanced.summary: Heart links: cast from a linked ally's place, share their wounds, heal through the bond.

moves.name: Link
moves.text: Bind your heart to one ally within {=effects.0.range} tiles (two from Will Power 5) for the scene, or until you're Downed.

mirror.text: a share of the heal or shield you received, to each linked ally

moves.name: Through
moves.text: Snap-cast (Begin and Release, at stage 0) or Release your held Outburst from a linked ally's position: range, sight and the shape run from their tile. Buffs you receive reach them at half.

moves.name: Share
moves.text: When a linked ally takes damage, take up to half of it yourself. Strain that would take a linked ally over their limit comes to you instead (as far as your limit allows); Take their Strain (1 AP, once a turn) moves up to 2. Heals you send through a link are x1.25. If a linked ally is Downed, you take 2 Strain.

effects.when: a linked ally's Strain would pass their limit; action take_strain moves 2

advanced.name: Vessel
advanced.summary: No Outbursts: the heart charges the body instead, then lets it all go in one strike.

moves.name: Inner Charge
moves.text: Begin's 2 AP, {=effects.0.mp} MP, 1 Strain: hold a body form like an Outburst. It starts at stage 1 and reads the stage table from there (stage 1 to stage 4), swells a stage each turn (1 Strain each) and can be Pumped ({=effects.0.pump_ap} AP, or an Empathy free Pump). Iron (armour +10), Surge (melee and unarmed damage +15), Swift (+2 Movement), Pain to Power (+{=effects.0.pump_ap} AP next turn per 20 damage taken, up to +2), Steady (no Prone or push; +2 Body saves), Heartbeat (heal 10 at turn start). At most 2 forms at once, whatever your Will Power.

damage.text: each form, times its stage multiplier

moves.name: Release
moves.text: End every form at once in one strike (free with a melee hit): +{=effects.0.per_stage} Soul damage x each form's stage multiplier, summed.

moves.name: Empty Hand
moves.text: Unarmed strikes deal {=effects.0.value} Physical for 2 AP. The Vessel can't design or cast Outbursts.

advanced.name: Twinbound
advanced.summary: Your soul's twin in the upper realm leans through: a companion with its own turn and three built-in Outbursts.

moves.name: Manifest
moves.text: Out of combat, once: design your Twin, its look (a portrait card) and three built-in Outbursts from schools and modules you know. They are fixed.

moves.name: Call
moves.text: The Twin appears within 3 tiles and takes its own turn after yours with {=effects.0.ap} AP: move, work its built-in Outbursts with its own heart (Begin, Pump, hold and Release at its own stage; your MP, your Strain; you and it don't resonate with each other) or Guard you. HP 50% of yours, your Defense, Movement 1.5, your Will Power; at most 6 tiles from you. On the area map the twin is a token with its own {=effects.0.ap} AP a round (moves only) and joins a fight opened there as the called twin.

moves.name: Bond
moves.text: If the Twin drops to 0 HP it vanishes and you take {=effects.0.strain} Strain; call it again next scene. In game text it is only ever the twin, and it never speaks of the upper realm.
